records.issue_text: History and Origin methods call s.search.History/Origin unconditionally without a nil check, causing nil-interface panics when search is unconfigured, unlike Search which has an explicit nil check
records.rationale: In pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go, Search now explicitly guards `if s.search == nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf("search index not configured") }`, but History and Origin do not: `return s.search.History(ctx, req)` and `return s.search.Origin(ctx, req)` (after removing the prior `s.Init(ctx)` call). If `s.search` is unconfigured/nil, these unguarded calls will panic due to a nil receiver/interface, unlike Search which returns an error.
